The MAX3485's receiver inputs are A and B. If B is biased at 1.65V, and A is connected to the bus, the receiver sees A-B. When the servo drives the bus, it drives A relative to GND. The MAX3485's receiver inputs are A and B. If B is biased at 1.65V, and A is connected to the bus, the receiver sees A-B. When the servo drives the bus, it drives A relative to GND.
